theorem_statement: For every stable pair (g,n) with g at most 7, the degree-sixteen rational cohomology of the complex Deligne-Mumford stack Mbar_{g,n} of stable genus-g curves with n ordered markings is a finite direct sum of Q(-8), with rank zero allowed. Equivalently H^{16}(Mbar_{g,n};Q) is isomorphic to Q(-8)^{oplus b_{g,n}} as a polarizable rational Hodge structure. No Betti-number formula, algebraic or tautological generation, integral statement, or coarse-moduli statement is asserted.
summary: The repaired Liu genus-five calculation, Ionel-Looijenga tautological vanishing, the primitive-quotient endpoint argument, and published CKgP/Borel-Moore ranges type every open term through genus seven. Strong induction on 3g-3+n types the normalized one-edge boundary using low-degree compact Tate results, odd vanishing, Kunneth, and finite-group invariants. The right-exact boundary sequence and semisimplicity type compact homology by Q(8); proper same-degree duality gives Q(-8) in cohomology.

claims.statement: The repaired genus-five input establishes A^*(M_{5,8})=R^*(M_{5,8}) and CKgP for M_{5,8}; combined with CLP Lemma 4.3 and Ionel's cohomological tautological vanishing it gives W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8};Q)=0 and W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{5,8};Q)=0.
claims.justification: Appendix 'The repaired genus-five input' of degree16_genus_le7.tex supplies the missing family inverses, corrected exceptional open, gerbe descent, affine-bundle step, irreducibility/Porteous argument, and gluing. The Revision-3 Codex audit confirms the corrected determinant-dual computation and the resulting four claims.

claims.statement: The primitive-quotient formula, strict virtual-cohomological-dimension vanishings, the inclusive CKgP marking endpoints, and Ionel-Looijenga vanishing give W_kH^k(M_{g,n};Q)=0 at (g,n,k)=(3,12,20),(6,6,26),(7,4,28); the direct-range cases (4,10) and repaired (5,8) also vanish.
claims.justification: This is Proposition 'endpoint-vanishing' and Corollary 'critical-vanishing' of the manuscript. The primitive degree is k-n=4g-4>vcd(Mod_g)=4g-5, the pullback source degree k exceeds vcd(PMod_{g,n-1})=k-1, and the psi source is tautological at n-1=c(g) in codimension at least g.

claims.statement: For every stable pair with 3<=g<=7, W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8), and it is zero whenever 2g+n>=11.
claims.justification: This is Proposition 'open-all'. BFP removes the high-marking range, Poincare duality reduces the rest to lowest weight, published CLP ranges handle all noncritical cases, and CLM-0148-1/2 handle the endpoints. Ionel-Looijenga gives the asserted stronger vanishing.

claims.statement: The compact base inputs hold: odd cohomology through degree nine vanishes; positive even cohomology through degree fourteen is Tate of its forced type; and H^{16} is Q(-8)-Tate for every stable pair of genus zero, one, or two.
claims.justification: Bergstrom-Faber-Payne supplies odd vanishing, Canning-Larson-Payne supplies even degree at most fourteen, Keel supplies genus zero, Petersen genus one, and CLP Corollary 2.7 genus two.

claims.statement: For a one-edge stable graph of type (g,n), every vertex pair is stable, has genus at most g, and has strictly smaller complex dimension than (g,n); a loop has ordered atlas Mbar_{g-1,n+2}, while a separating edge has a product of two smaller-dimensional factors.
claims.justification: This is the stable-graph and dimension bookkeeping in the induction section: partial normalization at the distinguished node lowers total complex dimension by one, and each stable factor has nonnegative dimension strictly below the parent.

claims.statement: If every degree-sixteen compact factor on a one-edge normalized boundary is Q(-8)-Tate, then Kunneth, the compact low-degree inputs, and rational graph-automorphism invariants make H^{16} of the normalized boundary Q(-8)-Tate and its boundary image in compact homology Q(8)-Tate.
claims.justification: Odd-odd Kunneth summands vanish because one degree is at most seven; positive even-even summands have degrees at most fourteen; axis terms use the degree-sixteen factor hypotheses. Finite rational invariants and quotients cannot introduce another Hodge type.

claims.statement: For every stable pair, the normalized-boundary map, compact homology, and lowest-weight open Borel-Moore term form a right-exact sequence in degree sixteen with no Gysin degree shift or Tate twist; its image is the kernel and the open term is the quotient.
claims.justification: This is CLP Equation (6.1), stated as the right-exact boundary proposition in the manuscript, followed by the definition of the boundary image.

claims.statement: Compact homology H_{16}(Mbar_{g,n};Q) is pure polarizable of weight -16. A short exact sequence with Q(8)-Tate kernel and quotient therefore has Q(8)-Tate middle term, and proper same-degree rational duality transfers this to Q(-8)-Tate H^{16}.
claims.justification: Smooth proper purity and rational Hodge duality give the middle object; semisimplicity of polarizable pure Hodge structures of fixed weight splits the extension. Proper duality is same-degree duality, not the dimension-dependent open Borel-Moore formula.

claims.statement: Strong induction on complex dimension proves the exact theorem simultaneously for every stable (g,n) with g<=7: genera zero through two are base inputs, and in genera three through seven every one-edge boundary factor lies at smaller dimension while the open quotient is CLM-0148-3.
claims.justification: CLM-0148-5 makes the induction well founded; CLM-0148-6 types the boundary image; CLM-0148-7/8 assemble and dualize the compact group. No induction hypothesis is used at the same or larger dimension.

failed_approaches_addressed: Do not use Liu's uncorrected exceptional open or omit the family inverse, gerbe descent, affine-bundle, or Porteous multiplicity repairs.
Do not infer Chow-level vanishing from Ionel; only tautological cohomology vanishing is used.
Do not replace the normalized-boundary proper pushforward by a shifted Gysin map.
Do not collapse a boundary source, its image, compact homology, and the open quotient to one carrier.
Do not claim tautological or algebraic generation of H^{16} from its Tate Hodge type.
